Location: Kajirchara , Howrah, West Bengal Date: August 24 Antarrashtriya Hindu Parishad and Bajrang Dal members raided a private Christian prayer meeting, harassing attendees and accusing them of facilitating religious conversions. They warned that such activities would not be tolerated in what they described as “Hindu localities.” They accused the preacher of receiving money to conduct religious conversions and dismissed faith-based healing as a “scam.” They also called the attendees “sinners” and “religious traitors,” repeatedly insisting that they were “originally” Hindu.

The game will likely be ported to PC by the community within 10 days, according… 🎮 - After a few hours of obtaining Cyberleek's final files, community projects behind the porting initiative have estimated a first unoptimized GTA VI PC build might obtainable in just a week. The community of gaming piracy, emboldened and strengthened by AI, has exponentially built up their capacities to crack heavily-protected games on PC and their ability to port console exclusives to PC in the past year. The era of console exclusives is likely coming to an end if gaming companies don't heavily invest in new protective measures. A successful GTA VI port to PC, for free, would bolster the piracy community like never before.

Therefore, the IAEA is calling on us to take an illegal action,” Hassan Ghashghavi, Iranian parliament National Security & Foreign Policy Committee spokesman, said Monday. The situation is surreal, Ghashghavi suggested, pointing out that the agency is demanding cooperation from Tehran on inspections while being pressured by “the vary same parties” that attacked Iran’s nuclear sites in the first place. “The agency’s demand runs counter to the NPT, to international law and to established international protocols…Therefore, no matter how many times they reiterate their points, it will not yield any results for them.” The true purpose of the inspection demands is to achieve through diplomatic pressure what the US and Israel failed to accomplish using military means, Ghashghavi added. At a recent IAEA board of governors meeting, director-general Rafael Grossi reiterated the agency’s demand for immediate access to Iran’s nuclear sites, saying otherwise, the agency won’t be able to certify that Iran isn’t diverting materials for non-peaceful purposes. The IAEA has never formally condemned the US and Israel’s attacks on Iran’s nuclear facilities.
